premises.text: Computing interfaces should be personal rather than one design for two billion users, and cluttered desktops and start menus confuse people
premises.evidence_span: tailored to the individual as opposed to a single solution needing to appease two billion users

premises.text: Lumiere enhances Windows with clean sortable workspaces instead of replacing the OS
premises.evidence_span: not a replacement for any sort of operating system, rather to embrace, extend, and enhance the system of choice of two billion people

value.text: Light up Windows so users understand and control their workspaces

causal_links.evidence_span: clean delineation of these spaces so you can understand and sort them yourself
